instructions_to_main_agent: Apply the cyberpunk design system across the app strictly using the provided colors, fonts, and effects.
Do NOT change any existing functionalities or React component behaviors. This is a visual redesign ONLY.
MUST include 'Chakra Petch', 'Orbitron', and 'Fira Code' fonts from Google Fonts in the main index.html or global css.
Add 'data-testid' to all interactive elements if not already present.
Do not use generic Shadcn default styling. Override background colors with `bg-cyber-navy` (or `#0F172A`) and borders with glowing neon borders.
Ensure all major backgrounds have either a dark gradient or a faint cyan/pink css grid.
Use glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl) on header navigation and dialog modals.
Implement neon glowing shadows (box-shadow or drop-shadow) on hover for buttons and cards.
For icons, use Lucide-react (already installed). Apply cyan or pink colors with drop-shadows to make them glow.
Eliminate heavy rounded corners. Use sharp corners (rounded-none or max rounded-sm) to match the futuristic/cyberpunk aesthetic.
Update Tailwind config to include the custom colors (`cyber-black`, `cyber-navy`, `cyber-cyan`, `cyber-pink`, `cyber-lime`) and custom fonts.

layouts.dashboards: Control Room grid. Density: tight (`gap-4` or `gap-6`). Strict grid hierarchy. Use sharp borders and 1px neon outlines to structure data.
layouts.marketing: Heavy asymmetry, bento grids, overlapping elements. Use high contrast and massive glowing typography. Embed background grids in sections.
layouts.code_editor: Maximize vertical space. Ensure Fira Code font is used exclusively in the code entry areas, accented by Neon Lime (#39FF14) for output success.

hero_background.description: Neon green diamond grid for use as a blended background layer in hero or marketing sections

code_abstract.description: Abstract green digital pattern with vertical lines, use as decorative image in code challenge pages or assignment lists

cyber_circuit.description: Motherboard circuits with neon glow, use as background pattern for teacher dashboard or login page
